text:
Asked: names of referred engineering students with counselling visits and disability type, for department heads.
Kind: a new internal purpose. The notice tells students that health and counselling data is seen only by the staff who provide those services.
Rules engaged: purpose limitation, minimisation, sensitive data (health data, PDPL Articles 1, 10, 11 and 23).
Next: I cannot send names, counselling or disability data. I can send the number of referred students per department and the share contacted by their advisor within two weeks. If you need more, the data protection officer decides: I have copied her.
